name: VORTEX
statement: A field of optical butterflies, suspended in a controlled spiral and designed as architecture rather than ornament.
description: VORTEX is AETHERIA's first implemented fixture. Its current engineering record defines a 240-element suspended composition with kinetic intent, a 4.8 m maximum drop and separated presentation, geometry and technical evidence domains.
behaviour: Actual motion, radial hierarchy, changing reflections and a luminous field that reads differently from every level.

name: VORTEX ECLIPSE
statement: The VORTEX language compressed into an orbit around a deliberate void.
description: ECLIPSE explores the butterfly module as a calmer horizontal chandelier. Layered orbits form a strong negative centre, allowing the composition to work above dining and hospitality spaces without repeating the vertical VORTEX silhouette.
behaviour: Optical orbit, layered depth and a central luminous absence that becomes part of the object.

name: VORTEX STRATA
statement: VORTEX becomes a ceiling landscape rather than a singular hanging object.
description: STRATA stretches the same motion logic into layered orbital bands. It is intended for wider hospitality and lounge volumes where the ceiling itself can carry the visual rhythm.
behaviour: Layered horizontal movement, repeated optical bands and changing overlap from circulation viewpoints.

name: VORTEX PORTAL
statement: A luminous threshold built from the movement language of VORTEX.
description: PORTAL turns the butterfly field upright and gives it a spatial job: marking arrival. The ring is intentionally incomplete in visual density so the composition feels like motion gathering and releasing around the opening.
behaviour: Circular flow, asymmetric density and a silhouette that changes as the viewer passes through it.

name: MIGRATION
statement: A rising directional field derived from migratory formation rather than a radial vortex.
description: MIGRATION studies elongated optical wing modules arranged along a shallow three-dimensional flight path. The goal is a clear sense of direction and collective movement without resolving into literal bird silhouettes.
behaviour: Directional edge glow, staggered hierarchy and a composition that appears to travel through the room.

name: CURRENT 01
statement: A frozen moment in a flowing world.
description: CURRENT abstracts fluid flow into a continuous optical ribbon. The body is conceived as the primary optical instrument: thick, transparent and shaped to make internal grazing, refraction and caustic behaviour part of the architecture.
behaviour: Frozen motion, internal light paths and optical distortion that changes with viewing angle.

name: SHOAL
statement: Many directional lenses behave as one current.
description: SHOAL explores schooling behaviour as an asymmetric horizontal field of smaller optical bodies. Individual elements are treated as directional lenses, not fish figurines, so highlight transfer and grouping create the sense of movement.
behaviour: Shimmer transfer, changing specular alignment and a broad current-like field rather than a central chandelier mass.

name: VEIN 01
statement: Nature's transport logic translated into light.
description: VEIN uses botanical branching as an internal light network rather than a literal leaf decoration. Light is imagined entering a refined optical body and dividing through branching channels with graded extraction.
behaviour: Branching light, thick optical depth and an off-state designed to read as sculptural material.

name: PETAL FIELD
statement: Overlapping growth becomes a field of luminous shells.
description: PETAL FIELD uses phase-offset shell packing rather than a literal flower centre. Curved optical shells overlap to create depth, shadow and edge glow, allowing a botanical reference to remain abstract.
behaviour: Layered edge glow, overlapping transparent depth and a changing silhouette from oblique views.

name: OCCULTATION
statement: Luminous crescents appear and disappear as layers move across the viewer's sightline.
description: OCCULTATION studies eclipse behaviour through incomplete arcs with transparent, smoked and reflective optical zones. The visual event is created by overlap and viewpoint rather than by adding decorative detail.
behaviour: Layered occlusion, changing crescents and a composition that resolves differently from each side of the room.

name: AURORA VEIL
statement: Atmospheric colour appears to move because the viewer moves.
description: AURORA VEIL explores thin transparent blades or films with interference behaviour held within a deeper structural frame. Colour is intended to shift with angle rather than function as static RGB decoration.
behaviour: View-dependent colour, layered transparency and optical movement without a motor.

name: SOLARA 02
statement: An orbital composition exploring balance, warm reflection and layered light.
description: SOLARA studies multiple ring scales and translucent optical elements as one suspended system. It broadens AETHERIA beyond biological motifs while retaining motion, material depth and precise suspension as the core language.
behaviour: Orbiting layers, reflected warm light and shifting alignments across the room.

name: PHASE
statement: Layered line fields create motion through interference rather than mechanics.
description: PHASE uses transparent optical planes with sparse line structures offset from one another. As a viewer moves past the fixture, moiré-like interference changes the apparent density and direction of the light field.
behaviour: Perceptual motion, layered interference and continuous viewpoint change.

name: TENSION
statement: Light paths appear stretched between precise structural nodes.
description: TENSION explores force flow as a form generator. A slender optical body is visually pulled between two authored nodes, with internal light paths following stress-like curves rather than conventional parallel channels.
behaviour: Directional tension, sparse structure and luminous paths that appear to carry force through the body.

name: LUMINA 03
statement: A falling-water field translated into suspended light.
description: LUMINA explores a large field of droplet-like optical elements organised into a wave rather than a conventional crystal chandelier. The intended character is calm, flowing and atmospheric rather than decorative sparkle alone.
behaviour: Vertical rhythm, wave-form density and repeated points of refraction across a large volume.
